server/internal/cli/cli.go.reason: Admin reset command deletes from a fixed allowlisted table set.

server/internal/integrations/thirdparty/.reason: Third-party account list, secret reference, and write queries are static and can be generated by sqlc.

server/internal/logging/repository.go.reason: Management log repository keeps static insert/detail queries with dynamic optional filters, cursor pagination, and pruning in one lifecycle-owned file.

server/internal/permission/checker.go.reason: Blacklist and whitelist repository queries are static CRUD and can be generated by sqlc.

server/internal/plugins/pluginstore/conf.reason: Plugin config read query composes optional namespace and key filters.

server/internal/plugins/pluginstore/kv.g.reason: Plugin KV list query uses escaped prefix filtering and pagination.

server/internal/render/repository/load.g.reason: Render template load and existence checks are static queries.

server/internal/render/repository/reposi.reason: Render template repository keeps revision save, validation update, and plugin cleanup SQL in one lifecycle-owned file; plugin cleanup composes variable plugin ID sets.

server/internal/render/repository/querie.reason: Render template list and version queries are static and can be generated by sqlc.

server/internal/render/repository/sql.go.reason: Render template local upsert and delete statements are static transaction queries.

server/internal/render/repository/sync.g.reason: Render template desired-state sync mixes transaction reads, deletes, and conditional updates.

server/internal/storage/integrity.go.reason: Storage integrity uses SQLite PRAGMA quick_check.

server/internal/storage/snapshot.go.reason: Storage snapshot uses PRAGMA setup and VACUUM INTO maintenance SQL.

server/internal/storage/store.go.reason: Storage lifecycle runs WAL checkpoint maintenance.

server/internal/storage/store_open.go.reason: Storage open configures SQLite PRAGMA settings.

server/internal/storage/store_schema.go.reason: Storage migration runner executes schema files, records migrations, and inspects SQLite schema metadata.
